import os
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace')
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Extend each horizontal colored band to the right using marker color 1.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = 8
    marker = 1
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colored = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
        if colored:
            end = max(colored)
            for c in range(end + 1, len(row)):
                out[r][c] = marker
    return out
'''
